values.name: Per unit
values.description: Referenced percentage applies on a single unit basis.

values.name: Per ton
values.description: Reduction percentage is applied per transported ton.

values.name: Per equipment unit
values.description: Reduction percentage is applied per main equipment unit (for rail purpose, only rail wagons).

values.name: Per unit price
values.description: Reduction percentage is applied on the unit price, which is the basis of the charge calculation.

values.name: Per quantity
values.description: Reduction percentage applied on the unit price and conceded to a consignor after he reached a specified tonnage of transport.

values.name: Basic charge
values.description: Code to indicate that the IATA experimental special charge within Europe is the basis for the percentage reduction or surcharge.

values.name: Rate per kilogram
values.description: Code to indicate that the IATA experimental special rate within in Europe is the basis for the percentage reduction or surcharge.

values.name: Minimum charge
values.description: Code to indicate that the IATA minimum charge is the basis for the percentage reduction or surcharge.

values.name: Normal rate
values.description: Code to indicate that the IATA normal rate is the basis for the percentage reduction or surcharge.

values.name: Quantity rate
values.description: Code to indicate that the IATA quantity rate is the basis for the percentage reduction or surcharge.

values.name: Amount of drawing
values.description: Referenced percentage applies on the amount of drawing under the documentary credit.

values.name: Documentary credit amount
values.description: Referenced percentage applies on documentary credit amount.

values.name: Invoice value
values.description: Referenced percentage applies on the invoice value.

values.name: CIF value
values.description: Referenced percentage applies on CIF value.
